req_desc: The product serves a public marketing site for an end to end merchandise service ...
The product owns one delivery date per order.
The product carries no comments feature ...
A Visitor reads every marketing route without signing in ...
A Buyer reads their own orders ...
A Viewer reads every project inside their own workspace ...
An Operator writes briefs ...
A Finance member reads the money ledger ...
An Owner changes member roles inside their own workspace ...
The acting role is read from the membership row rather than from a request body.
The server rejects a Viewer session calling an Operator-only endpoint ...
Signup is open to anyone ...
The seeded Owner of Tidewater Goods is `owner@example.com` ...
Email with password is exchanged for a bearer token ...
A password is stored under a memory-hard hash rather than in recoverable form ...
A token replayed after sign-out is denied.
A reset request answers identically for an unknown address.
Nine public marketing routes are served on the same origin as the console ...
The intro reel plays once per session.
The intro reel never blocks navigation to another route.
The header is a floating pill carrying the wordmark, two dropdown menus, a whitelist link ...
The footer carries four columns over the copyright line on every route.
Each public route leads with one primary action distinct from every secondary one.
The hero carries a backer endorsement chip, the display headline, the two-line standfirst, the mascot.
Thirteen pills fall, collide, come to rest in a heap ...
The pills' words are present as an ordinary list for assistive technology.
Under a reduced-motion preference the simulation does not run ...
The simulation stops stepping once off screen ...
Four capability panels each carry a headline, a line of copy, a working product mock.
The extras grid carries eight cards, each with a status chip.
The catalogue lists eight products ...
`Acid-Wash Patch Tee` starts at `3400` minor units with a minimum of `100` ...
The five category chips read `All`, `Apparel`, `Outerwear`, `Headwear`, `Accessories` ...
The catalogue keeps the price beside the minimum on the card at every width.
`Start a project` opens a brief with that product already chosen.
A marketing price is read from the catalogue the quoting engine reads.
The fulfillment page carries the line `Nobody owns the delivery date.` ...
The fulfillment page carries the figure `11` for operations surfaces run ...
Six subject sections follow, each a heading above a paragraph ...
Four questions follow in an accordion ...
The no-minimum route offers a path into a brief ...
The about route carries the company position on the paper ground with drifting panels.
The field-note categories are `Supply chain`, `Commerce`, `Industry`.
Brand kit swatches are generated from the same token source the site reads.
The terms document is served at `/legal/website-terms-of-use` ...
The privacy statement is served at `/legal/privacy` ...
An unknown address renders the product's own screen carrying `Page not found` ...
Every internal link on every public route resolves.
`/sitemap.xml` lists every public route ...
No two public routes share a title ...
A member works inside one brand workspace holding projects.
The project list is a grid of cards, each carrying a state chip above the next action.
Global search reaches nothing outside the caller's own workspace.
The notification centre carries promise revisions, stock refusals, quality decisions, support escalations, newest first.
Creating a project is its own route reachable by address.
Every console list carries a designed empty state naming its one next action.
A brief records the base product, the quantity, the colourways, the size curve, the target landed price, the needed-by date.
The four decoration methods are `screen_print`, `embroidery`, `patch`, `wash`.
Artwork needs at least `150` pixels per inch at the printed size ...
An artwork refusal names the offending measurement in the artwork's own terms ...
A brief whose artwork has not passed cannot request quotes.
A console form refuses invalid input inline, names the field, writes nothing.
Requesting quotes fans a brief out to every eligible supplier ...
A restart loses no quote request, reply or reminder.
An offer records its currency, its incoterm, its unit basis, its setup fee, its lead time, its validity.
Every offer normalises to one landed cost per unit in integer minor units at the brief's quantity ...
A per-dozen quote of `46800` minor units is `3900` minor units per piece ...
The seeded `aveiro-knitworks` landed cost per unit is `5144` minor units ...
Offers are compared only after normalisation ...
A later rate movement never changes a historical quote.
`aveiro-knitworks` steps its unit cost at `250`, `500`, `1000` units.
An offer expires `14` days after the offer is made ...
A supplier's quoted prices never appear in a storefront payload ...
A sample round records what was requested, what arrived, evidence per angle, measurements against a size specification ...
A defect records a grade from the three the brief pins above a location on the garment.
A rework carries its defect list forward into the next round.
An approval records who accepted, when, against which evidence, immutably.
The seeded acceptance rule inspects `80` units from a run of `500` ...
An inspection that exceeds the acceptance rule blocks the shipment ...
A run walks the stages `purchase_order`, `deposit`, `materials`, `production`, `quality`, `packing`, `freight_handover`.
Each run stage records an expected window, an actual, an owning member.
A slipped stage recomputes the projected ready date ...
A run splits across two factories with lots tracked separately.
A purchase order records its deposit percentage above its payment terms.
Stock lives in the two locations `rotterdam`, `newark`.
The inventory ledger kinds are `receipt`, `reservation`, `allocation`, `pick`, `shipment`, `return`, `write_off`, `transfer_out`, `transfer_in` ...
`on_hand` is summed from the ledger every time the figure is read ...
`available` equals `on_hand` minus reservations minus damaged.
An order reserves stock when placed, allocates at pick ...
Two orders racing for the last unit resolve to exactly one reservation ...
Units in a departed transfer belong to neither location until receipt ...
An order routes to the location that can serve the destination ...
A forecast produces a projected stockout date beside a suggested reorder point.
Each workspace publishes one hosted storefront with collections, product pages, a cart, a checkout.
Gate audience tests compose with `and`, `or`, `not`.
Gate evaluation runs on the server at render ...
The seeded gated listing `holder-work-jacket` carries a holder price of `5900` minor units ...
Proving an entitlement recomputes the catalogue, the prices, the perks in place without a page reload.
A disconnecting visitor returns cleanly to the ungated state ...
Proving an address is a signature challenge carrying a nonce above an expiry ...
An order is priced once, with tax computed before payment.
An order reference is `KLN-` followed by six digits, for example `KLN-000412`.
A settled fiat order creates or reuses one billing account keyed by the buyer's address lowercased ...
A replayed `Idempotency-Key` returns the original order with no second invoice ...
A token quote holds for `15` minutes against a recorded rate ...
An underpayment credits what arrived, leaving the order awaiting the balance ...
The receipt, the order record, the finance report agree to the minor unit.
A refund never exceeds the captured amount.
Every money movement is a row in an append-only ledger.
The eleven operations surfaces are `receiving`, `put_away`, `storage`, `replenishment`, `pick`, `pack`, `carrier_handoff`, `customs`, `sales_tax`, `tracking`, `returns`.
A carrier outage reroutes the parcel, recording the cost difference.
A tracking event resent by a carrier notifies the buyer once.
An address failure, a customs hold, damage in transit, carrier loss each carry a defined path with an owner.
Every product carries a customs classification code, a country of origin, a declared value basis.
A missing classification blocks the dispatch before the parcel leaves ...
Duty is estimated at checkout for delivered-duty-paid destinations as its own line ...
The seeded jurisdiction `NL` charges `21` percent, rounding per invoice ...
The sum of per-line tax equals the invoice tax exactly ...
Three `NL` lines of `3333`, `3333`, `3334` minor units carry an invoice tax of `2100` minor units ...
Refunding one line returns exactly the tax recorded against that line.
The seeded nexus threshold is `10000000` minor units in a calendar year.
A period filing report balances to a difference of zero.
A return walks authorisation, a label, receipt, inspection, then `restock`, `refurbish` or `write_off`.
The refund with the inventory event issue from one inspection decision.
A cross-border return generates its own customs paperwork.
The return policy recorded on the order governs the refund rather than today's setting.
The return window is `30` days from delivery ...
A buyer is given one delivery window at checkout.
A promise records the inputs that produced the window.
Every open promise carries one owning stage.
A moved input recomputes the window, recording the revision with its cause ...
A factory slip, a carrier degradation, a customs hold together produce one recomputed window.
The console ranks every promise at risk by how far the promise has slipped.
On-time performance reports by stage, by supplier, by carrier, by lane.
The seeded drop `kilnfolk-winter` carries a supply of `40` ...
A fixed drop supply never oversells under a rush ...
A late arrival receives an honest queue position rather than a spinner.
The seeded odds are `common` at `0.70`, `rare` at `0.25`, `grail` at `0.05`.
Published odds stay immutable for the whole time a drop runs.
A seed digest is published before the drop opens ...
A pull that would exceed its outcome's remaining stock is prevented before the money is taken.
The realised distribution reconciles against the published odds after the drop closes.
The seeded pre-sale threshold is `5000000` minor units ...
A machine-readable catalogue exposes products, variants, prices, availability, lead times ...
An agent order walks the same reservation, tax, promise machinery a buyer walks.
An agent credential carries an owner, scopes, a spend limit, a rate limit.
Revoking a credential releases its open reservations.
A drop allowance counts a buyer's own orders together with their agents' orders.
The same period totalled by different axes agrees exactly.
A support conversation carries the order context.
An assistant answer cites a procedure version or escalates.
An answer records which procedure version the answer was drafted from ...
An announcement honours the suppression list.
An unsubscribe takes effect across every future send.
An order confirmation subject begins `Kilnly order confirmed: ` before the order reference ...
A confirmation reaches the ordering buyer's address alone with nobody in copy.
Moving an order from `picked` to `packed` sends no mail.
A holder's standing is computed at read time from current entitlements ...
A cached standing is invalidated when an entitlement changes.
The holders hub shows what a holder owns beside what is redeemable now.
A claim marks the entitlement, reserves stock, creates the order together or not at all.
A failure in any claim leg unwinds the other two.
A claim racing a transfer of the same entitlement resolves once.
An unclaimed entitlement past its window is reported rather than silently expired.
Every allowlist entry records why the entry exists.
The run cost model carries unit cost, tooling, freight, duty, insurance, inspection, warehousing, pick-and-pack, carrier cost, payment fees, a returns allowance.
Margin is computed against the landed cost of the lot a unit came from.
Cost of goods sold uses the lots actually shipped rather than an average ...
The quoting engine refuses a lead time a supplier's throughput cannot support.
The landing route is `/` ...
An unauthenticated request for a console route lands on sign-in, returning afterwards ...
A visitor throws the pile, then filters the catalogue, then starts a project.
An entitled buyer watches the gated price appear in place with no page reload.
Every list carries a designed empty state naming its one next action ...
The product is built to one north star, a founder believing real objects can be made without holding the chain in mind ...
The page ground is a warm near-white, nearer paper than white ...
The interface family is `Inter` ...
The pill is the dominant shape from the header through the chips to the buttons ...
Everything moves on one character, settling rather than snapping ...
The console places navigation down the left, work in the middle ...
Every control carries resting, pointed-at, pressed, focused, unavailable states ...
At a narrow viewport nothing overflows sideways ...
The frontend is SolidJS built with Vite ...
No second datastore, cache, queue, object store, identity provider or mail vendor is introduced.
A call under `/1.0/kb/` carries `X-Killbill-ApiKey` beside `X-Killbill-ApiSecret` ...
The loser of a race for the last unit receives a `409` conflict response naming the stock keeping unit.
Money is integer minor units throughout, never a floating-point value ...
One event stream carries order transitions, inventory events, promise revisions, tracking updates ...
The inventory grid holds its frame rate at ten thousand rows.
Product photography is generated from a seed derived from the product's slug.
`GET /api/health` returns `200` once the app is ready.
Uploaded artwork is delivered through short-lived signed links, stripped of metadata.
Every seeded account uses the password `deku-demo-pw-2026` ...
A `membership` row carries its workspace, its account, its role ...
The four product categories are `apparel`, `outerwear`, `headwear`, `accessories`.
The stock keeping unit `KJ-WORK-M` is the `Washed Work Jacket` in medium.
A `project` moves forward only through its states.
An `artwork` row records its pixel width, its colour count, its bleed, its state.
A `landed_cost` row stores every component separately.
An `offer` is immutable once made.
An `inventory_event` row carries its stock keeping unit, its location, its kind, its units.
A `transfer` in state `departed` holds units that belong to neither location.
An `order` records the return policy that applied when the order was placed ...
An `order_line` records its tax allocation.
One capture exists per idempotency key.
The money ledger kinds are `settlement`, `refund`, `reversal`, `presale_held`, `payout`, `fee`.
A `tax_rate` row carries its jurisdiction, its rate, its effective date, its rounding rule.
A `promise_revision` records its cause.
A `pull` is verifiable against the revealed seed.
A stored order records the version of the rules the order was written under ...
Seeding is idempotent, so restarting the app duplicates no row ...
Content sits inside a ladder of ten fixed measures rather than a fluid width ...
A four-step ink-alpha ladder carries hairlines, dividers, secondary text, the card shadow ...
Body text sits at 16px with dense interface text at 14px ...
The wordmark is drawn geometry of four closed letterform paths rather than a font glyph ...
A chevron rotates a half turn when its disclosure opens ...
The intro reel's first line reads `Pondering manufacturers...` ...
The header's two menu labels read `Past drops`, `Kilnfolk` ...
The footer copyright line reads `(C) 2026 Kilnly` ...
A text link falls to about two thirds of its strength when pointed at.
Buttons come in three, a signal pill, an ink pill, a ghost with a hairline border ...
Ten named motion moments share the product's one character ...
The hero headline reads `Create your dream merch on autopilot` ...
The first pill reads `emailing 12 manufacturers`.
The catalogue page is headed `Latest productions`.
The fulfillment page is headed `Merch fulfillment, end to end.` ...
The console adds no colour, no new corner softness, no new spacing step, no new type step ...
Product photography is a seeded flat-lay silhouette on the paper ground under a soft shadow ...
One workspace's data is unreachable from another through search ...
Supplier terms never appear in a buyer-reachable export.
No real carrier, customs authority, tax authority or chain node is contacted.
The server makes no call to any host outside the environment at run time.
No native application, browser extension or desktop client ships.
No direct messaging between buyers exists.
No card primary account number is stored anywhere ...
The product stays responsive with ten thousand orders.
The app is reachable at `APP_PUBLIC_URL` ...
The HTTP API is served on that same origin under the `/api` prefix.
The app starts from the environment image with no manual steps.
A reserved `.browser_screenshots/` directory exists empty at the app root ...
A production build is served behind a static or preview server.
The server keeps running after the session ends.
The server binds `0.0.0.0`.
The backing services are already running, so none is downloaded or started.
No persistent volumes, no fixed container names, no custom networks.
A list endpoint returns a top-level JSON array ...
An in-memory array of orders is a contract violation ...
